profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Rio Rancho, New Mexico, United States
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with strong experience in frontend, backend, and DevOps. I directed moving a legacy monolithic enterprise system to well-tested serverless event-driven architecture in AWS. I've built the frontend of an NFT trading platform with a unique mutli-wallet login system. I've worked on SaaS products featured in the New York Times and the Wall Street Journal. I've built an IoT product used in universities and schools. I love solving hard problems and I'm willing to work in whatever technology helps me solve those problems.

I'm experienced in React, Next.js, Node.js, Jest, Cypress, Python, pytest, AWS, Serverless Framework, React Native, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, PHP, and more.

positions.locationName: Albuquerque, New Mexico, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Helped move the main company brands from old server rendered sites to Next.js sites with testing, CI/CD, linting, TypeScript. Sites were also built to use Content Management tools by marketing to allow them greater freedom to quickly launch new content without code changes.

Managed websites responsible for over $24 million of direct to consumer sales.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Moved aging architecture to Azure Cloud, implemented queuing for greater resiliency in all systems, added alarms for failing processes, and implemented CI/CD with Azure DevOps. Built a real-time order data lake. Launched 2 new sites while also moving the company to BigCommerce v3 multi-store front.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Albuquerque, New Mexico, United States · Remote
positions.description: Built a highly interactive, data-rich, NFT aggregator and marketplace as the sole frontend developer. Created a custom multi-wallet login system that also tied to traditional social and email logins. Built dynamic Open Graph images that were built with Node.js canvas and then cached on the edge. Worked with Web3 using React, GraphQL, ReactNative, Serverless Framework.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Architecture · Maintainability · Distributed Systems · Web Applications · Programming · Imperative Programming · Data Structures · Communication

positions.title: Head Of Engineering
positions.description: Built a blended product and technical roadmap to improve the code base and infrastructure while still building the business. Used data analysis to reduce false positives in the system by 80%.

positions.title: Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description: Directed moving a legacy code base to well-tested, serverless services on AWS, both improving resiliency and increasing developer confidence in shipping. Oversaw the team size doubling.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Built technology that fights recidivism and incarceration used by court systems in 40 states. React, ReactNative, Native iOS and Android, Python, Node.js, PHP, PostgreSQL, MySQL.

positions.title: Co-founder / Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Founded and built a software development firm that grew to 13 employees before selling it. Some of our more exciting projects included:

- Built a SaaS product featured in the New York Times, the Wall Street Journal, Vogue, Psychology Today and NPR
- Built a custom e-commerce and operations solution for a tourism company that had $3m in revenue and thousands of clients yearly
- Worked on a marketing SaaS platform that had 100,000 active users with a legacy code base and helped their development team move to a modern framework and web development environment
- Built an award-winning IoT product for sporting events at schools and universities
- Built an Android Wear drink tracker app for a substance abuse company to allows clients to discretely tracking their drinking
- Helped a company realize a 17% labor reduction with custom operations software
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Architecture · Maintainability · Web Applications · Programming · Back-End Web Development · Imperative Programming · Data Structures · Communication

positions.description: Taught agile web development and software testing with PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
